Severn Padel and Pizza for Established GPs

Monday 18 January 2027

Padel from 19.00; Pizza from 20.00

Arrival/meeting time at 18:45 







Padel is a form of tennis that's rapidly growing across Europe. We have organised a chance to try padel, meet up with other established GPs from the area and enjoy a pizza afterwards. This is open to RCGP members ( 5 years post CCT) and will take place at Padel4all, Lockleaze Sports Centre, Bonnington Walk, Lockleaze, Bristol BS7 9XF https://padel4all.com/lockleaze/  




The main purpose of this event is to allow a networking opportunity for established GPs in the area. We are therefore particularly keen to attract doctors, in the middle of their career, who aren't represented by our colleagues working with the First5 and Later Career and Retired Members groups. If you are keen to network but don't want to play padel and/or eat pizza, you are still very welcome.




We will be booking this event in groups of four so as we meet the minimum/maximum for each group then the bookings will be confirmed for the courts.  If the tickets are not showing/sold out, please email to be placed on a waiting list. Tickets will then be released when we reach enough for a second court.




If you have any dietary requirements please advise.

 

The facility has on site parking.




This event is free for members( 5 years post CCT), however your card details will be taken to cover the £15 deposit to reserve your place and this will only be charged in the event of non-attendance or cancellation within the period outlined below. Charges are processed on the 1st of the following month.

Non-members will be charged £24 (inc VAT), these tickets will be released closer to the date.




Cancellation:

If you are unable to attend, cancellations made more than 14 days before the event can be completed via the MyRCGP area of the website. 




For cancellations within 14 days, please contact the event organiser below. Please be aware that for cancellations within this time, event deposits will still be taken and refunds for tickets will not be issued.




Coordinated by:

Dr Ali Hutchings, Severn Established GPs Representative

Jane Lohmann, Severn Faculty Administrator




If you have any questions or wish to be place on the waiting list, please email: severn@rcgp.org.uk




The RCGP is committed to cultivating and preserving a culture of inclusion, celebrating diversity and ensuring our members feel valued. Equality and inclusion are essential principles in our work and this meeting will be conducted in a way which reflects the diverse communities and respects individual differences. By attending this event, you are agreeing to welcome and respect the unique contributions and life experiences of each attendee and the speakers and abide by our event code of conduct. Read the code of conduct.
